gameDescriptionHtml:
Drop Dead: The Cabin is a multiplayer survival horror FPS that throws you and a friend into a pulse-pounding, 1980s-inspired nightmare. Developed by Soul Assembly, this PC & VR-compatible shooter blends co-op action, roguelike replayability, and a retro horror aesthetic into a brutal fight for survival.

Lost in the woods, you stumble across a seemingly abandoned cabin. But this is no ordinary hideout. It was once home to the twisted scientist Dr. Monday, whose experiments have unleashed a deadly horde of undead abominations. Now, the forest is crawling with monstrosities, and the only thing standing between you and certain death is your skill, your weapons, and your ability to work as a team.

Fight to keep the power running, the lights on, and the comms active. Let the systems fail, and the undead become faster, deadlier, and harder to see. Every decision matters. In solo or online co-op, teamwork is key. Stay together or split up to complete critical survival objectives. Use the environment to your advantage and fight with precision to survive the night.

Playable in both PC and on VR headsets, Drop Dead: The Cabin brings intense action to every player. Inspired by classic horror films and series like Stranger Things, it blends fast-paced wave shooting with immersive storytelling and endlessly replayable combat.

Do you have what it takes to escape the cabin… or will you join Monday’s monstrosities?

Game Features

  • Intense Survival Combat – Engage in fast, brutal wave-based combat using guns, melee weapons, and environmental tactics. Grab your gear, reload manually, aim for the head, and feel the impact through physics-based interaction and advanced haptics.
  • Solo or Online Co-op – Play alone or with a friend. Stick together or divide and conquer as you complete objectives, defend the cabin, and face increasing challenges.
  • PC and VR Support – Experience the horror your way. Full support for both VR and traditional PC play with controls designed for both styles.
  • 80s Horror Atmosphere – Neon lights, synth music, and VHS-style horror vibes. Fans of retro horror and shows like Stranger Things will feel right at home – or deeply unsettled.
  • Endlessly Replayable – Each run is different. Objectives, enemy spawns, pickups, and encounters are remixed every time for maximum replay value.
  • Unique Proto-Zombie Enemies – Face off against strange creatures born from twisted experiments. Adapt your strategy to survive increasingly aggressive monstrosities.
  • Level Up and Escape – Upgrade your weapons, boost your skills, and fight your way toward escape. Survive long enough to unlock new perks and find your way out of the nightmare.
